title: Why 5 Trusted Peers Beat 10,000 Shallow Contacts
alt_title_1: Dunbar's Number & Weak Ties: The Science of High-Trust Networks
alt_title_2: Stop Collecting Connections (Use the 5 + 2 Relationship Rule)
description_hook: Oxford anthropologist Robin Dunbar proved in 1992 that human brain architecture limits stable relationships to ~150 people, with an inner core of just 5. Combined with Mark Granovetter's 1973 Weak Ties research, here is a smarter way to build career relationships.

scenes.headline: Why 10,000 Followers Still Feels Lonely
scenes.stat_label: HARD BIOLOGICAL CEILING ON REAL TIES
bullets: Digital contact lists scale infinitely on a screen
Human neocortex bandwidth has not changed in millennia
scenes.narration: Collecting ten thousand online contacts feels productive, yet primate brain biology caps how many real relationships any human can actually sustain.
scenes.source: Robin Dunbar, Journal of Human Evolution (1992)

scenes.headline: Robin Dunbar's 1992 Neocortex Limit
bullets: ~150 total stable social ties; ~15 close allies
Just 5 intimate high-trust confidants form your core
scenes.narration: In 1992, Oxford anthropologist Robin Dunbar showed in the Journal of Human Evolution that neocortex size limits stable human networks to roughly one hundred fifty people, anchored by an inner circle of five.
scenes.source: Robin I. M. Dunbar, J. Human Evolution, Vol. 22, No. 6 (1992)

scenes.headline: Shallow Feeds Starve Both Core & Weak Ties
scenes.left_body: 10,000 cold DMs & feed likes -> zero candor when stakes rise
scenes.right_body: 5 deep kitchen-cabinet peers + warm check-ins with weak ties
scenes.narration: Spreading attention thinly across noisy feeds starves both your five high-trust peers and what sociologist Mark Granovetter in 1973 called valuable weak ties.
scenes.source: Mark S. Granovetter, 'The Strength of Weak Ties', American Journal of Sociology (1973)

scenes.headline: Install the Weekly 5 + 2 Relationship Cadence
scenes.stat_subtext: 80% energy in 5 core peers + 2 weekly no-ask notes -> lifelong trust
scenes.narration: Build a two-tier network: invest eighty percent of your relational energy into five candid builders, and send two thoughtful no-ask notes weekly to respected weak ties.

scenes.headline: Depth Protects You, Bridges Expand You
scenes.stat_label: FIVE INNER ALLIES • TWO WARM BRIDGES WEEKLY
bullets: Your inner 5 sharpen your thinking and tell hard truths
Respected weak ties open doors outside your daily bubble
scenes.narration: Depth in your inner five builds resilience, while genuine curiosity across weak ties brings fresh opportunity.
scenes.source: Mind & Margin synthesis of Dunbar (1992) & Granovetter (1973)
